visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair, wearing a grey suit jacket over a black shirt, stands in a brightly lit studio/office. He is positioned in front of a whiteboard with drawings and text. He uses wide hand gestures while speaking to students, whose backs are partially visible in the foreground. (2) The camera zooms in on the man's face as he exhibits an exaggerated expression of shock, touching his temples with both hands. He then points and gestures aggressively toward a student holding a smartphone. (3) The man walks toward a female student who is looking down at a smartphone. The setting includes a brick-patterned wall and a door in the background. The student looks up with a concerned facial expression while holding the device. (4) The student shows the screen of her phone to the man. His facial expression shifts from anger to touched and moved, placing his hands over his heart. He gestures toward himself and the whiteboard behind him. (5) The man holds a large red gift box with a phoenix illustration. He points to the box and smiles broadly, demonstrating the product to the camera. The background shows a "THE DODO MEN" logo on a grey wall. (6) A series of close-up shots show the man's hands tearing open a red foil pouch and drinking its contents. Another shot shows a red pouch being placed into a bowl of water and then into a microwave oven. (7) The man opens the gift box to reveal several red pouches and a gold-colored ceramic bowl nestled inside. He presents the contents to the camera with an enthusiastic expression. (8) A close-up shows the golden bowl filled with a brown liquid. The man holds up a single red pouch next to his face, giving a thumbs up. (9) The man stands holding the red gift box, waving one hand toward the camera in a goodbye gesture while smiling. The scene returns to the initial classroom setting with the whiteboard.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern indoor space featuring a whiteboard, 'DODO IT' and 'THE DODO MEN' wall branding, brick accents, a computer monitor, and a small kitchen area with a microwave.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, energetic electronic beat. A male voice speaks with high projection and a teaching persona, using clear articulation in Mandarin and English. (2) A loud 'Whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. The male voice shifts to a sharp, high-pitched shout of 'OMG!', followed by an aggressive, fast-paced lecture tone. The BGM remains driving and consistent. (3) A subtle mechanical click is heard. A female voice speaks at a moderate conversational volume with a slightly trembling, defensive tone. (4) A sudden, dramatic melodic swell in the music occurs. The male voice's intensity drops, becoming soft, breathy, and performatively sentimental, saying 'For me?'. (5) A 'Ding' sound effect signals the introduction of the product. The male voice becomes bright and promotional, speaking with professional broadcasting clarity. The BGM shifts to a lighthearted, bouncy pop track. (6) Distinct sound effects of plastic rustling (tearing a pouch) and liquid splashing are audible. A mechanical beep from a microwave sounds. (7) The male voice continues with a warm, encouraging tone, describing product features like temperature and ingredients. (8) The video concludes with the male voice saying 'See ya~' with a rising intonation, followed by a final rhythmic beat and a fade-out of the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Conflict -> Resolution/Twist -> Product Demonstration -> CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote '芳茲滴雞精' (Fun-Zhi Drip Chicken Essence) as an ideal gift for the Lunar New Year. The video uses a comedic skit involving a strict English teacher being moved by a student's thoughtfulness to create a seamless transition into a detailed product showcase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the gift box, demonstration of product use (tearing, heating, drinking), mention of discount code 'dodomen', and explicit verbal recommendation.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully merges educational comedy with commercial advertising, leveraging the 'The Dodo Men' brand personality.
